claims.label: A
claims.text: G10 Lemmas 5.53 to 5.55 and Corollary 5.56: at one vertex of a position product event on a ring the numbers of left steps form a gap-free progression of difference M with n(l)n(l+2M) <= n(l+M)(n(l+M)-1), likewise across the two rails; for three or more classes of winding the preparation of all pairs does not exist.
claims.criterion: Supported in scope if the proof follows on reading and the exchanged walks, built one by one, satisfy every step in the range examined.

claims.label: B
claims.text: G10 Proposition 5.57: without (bc/a^2)^M = 1 the ring preparation holds on multisets of one coset of <delta>, and the conclusion of Theorem 5.51(i) when the winding gain lies in <delta>, given that the one-gain construction deposits walks of one number of left steps.
claims.criterion: Conditional unless the property of the construction is proved; supported as a conditional if the proof follows and replays show the property.

claims.label: C
claims.text: G10 Theorem 5.59: on rings with M at least 8 and two classes of winding the consistent site-independent rules are the count and the squares of the characters of Delta_N with value -1 on delta, given Proposition 5.58.
claims.criterion: Conditional on Proposition 5.58; supported as a conditional if the proof follows on reading, the step replacing Step 6 checks in Lean, and exact ranks on actual carriers equal the formula.

claims.label: D
claims.text: G8 Proposition 5.2(c), proof: the ring generated by chi(H_e) is not dense in C for orders 3, 4 and 6; the statement follows from the density of its field of fractions.
claims.criterion: Supported if the corrected step follows and the earlier clause is false for the named orders.

claims.label: E
claims.text: For three or more classes of winding the count and the squares are the only consistent site-independent rules on the multisets that occur.
claims.criterion: Supported only by a proof; computations on single rings leave it unresolved.
